$comment: Vendored capability skills, pinned by commit SHA + content hash. Workflow skills we author live in .agents/skills/ and are NOT listed here. Skills vendored from a non-git source are pinned by content hash alone (pin: content-hash) — `make skills-verify` still detects an in-place edit, which is what stops a vendored copy drifting from its source unnoticed. Add with `make skills-add`; verify with `make skills-verify`.
